title: anguina pilosa
intro: Anguina pilosa, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Anguina pilosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Anguina pilosa include ferulic acid, apiol, and ligustilide, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
